- mainnet_block_44085599_extradata.hex, mainnet_block_44107199_extradata.hex: extraData of mainnet blocks 44085599 and 44107199 (debug_getRawBlock from a private mainnet RPC node, copied from internal/consensus/testdata), the on-chain DKG outcomes for epochs 2041 and 2042.
- rust_messages.json: produced by the Rust harness (~/goempo-work/wire/harness on a 32-core build machine, commonware 2026.10.0) with the same 4 keys and sharing as internal/consensus/wire/testdata/rust_golden.json: tempo DKG channel messages (Dealer = DealerPubMsg||DealerPrivMsg, Ack = PlayerAck, behind the epoch mux varint) for a fresh round (epoch 1) and a reshare round (epoch 2), every dealer to every player, plus each dealer's SignedDealerLog.
